title: [FLINK-39517][runtime-web] Resolve SemVer-compatible npm advisories
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

This PR resolves the subset of `npm audit` advisories in `flink-runtime-web/web-dashboard` that can be fixed without any `package.json` changes — i.e., within the currently declared SemVer ranges. Running `npm audit fix` bumps transitive dependencies to their latest patch-compatible versions, clearing 24 of the 55 advisories reported against the web dashboard (14 high, 7 moderate, 3 low).

The remaining 31 advisories (including 2 critical — `form-data`, `request`) require major-version upgrades to `package.json` and are out of scope for this PR; they are tracked as a follow-up sub-task under the parent JIRA.

## Brief change log

- Ran `npm audit fix --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` in `flink-runtime-web/web-dashboard`
- Only `package-lock.json` changes (+3826 / −3141); `package.json` is untouched
- Notable transitive bumps include:
  - `lodash` 4.17.21 → 4.18.1 — prototype pollution / code injection
  - `tar` 6.2.1 / 7.4.3 → 7.5.13 — path traversal, symlink poisoning
  - `node-forge` 1.3.1 → 1.4.0 — ASN.1 / signature forgery
  - `path-to-regexp` 0.1.12 / 8.2.0 → 0.1.13 / 8.4.2 — ReDoS
  - `glob` 10.4.5 → 13.0.6 — command injection
  - `minimatch` — ReDoS
  - `flatted`, `immutable`, `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`, `body-parser`, `js-yaml`, `yaml`, `follow-redirects`, `diff`, `brace-expansion`

## Verifying this change

This change is a lockfile-only dependency patch and carries no test coverage implications. Verified locally:

- `npm run build` — production build succeeds
- `npm run lint` — lint passes
- `npm audit` severity counts drop from 55 (2 critical / 30 high / 17 moderate / 6 low) to 31 (2 critical / 16 high / 10 moderate / 3 low); no new advisories introduced

## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): **yes** (transitive only; `package.json` declared ranges unchanged)
  - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: **no**
  - The serializers: **no**
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): **no**
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: **no**
  - The S3 file system connector: **no**

## Documentation

  - Does this pull request introduce a new feature? **no**
  - If yes, how is the feature documented? **not applicable**
